Implemented
  Settings persists app-only System / Light / Dark appearance. Explicit native themes
  cover subsequently created dialogs and inputs; real system configuration is preserved.
  Default USB / Wi-Fi preset transport is persistent and independent of actual status.
  Settings can configure and probe wireless Picture Control without a selected preset
  or an album connection. Imports retain fresh capability/slot checks, confirmation,
  one registration attempt, exact readback and uncertain-result journal recovery.
  Root/detail entrances use 220ms alpha/translation; photo navigation uses 180ms fade.
  Transitions interrupt safely and respect disabled system animators.
  Downloaded NCPs, including downloaded online cards, render over a shared template.
  Preview badges and detail copy explicitly identify the result as a phone approximation.
  Built-in AI template can be replaced/reset; original and real references remain separate.
  Unsupported NCPs do not receive fabricated effects; failures allow reason/retry.
  Capped image requests expose a load action rather than leaving an unretryable placeholder.
  Custom JPEG is content addressed, fully published and verified before committing its
  preference reference. Failed saves retain a usable old reference. Source NCP is unchanged.

Limits
  Preview supports the strict researched 638-byte NCP0100 color subset. Encoded-RGB
  per-channel LUT and HSV mappings are explicit app approximations, not Nikon's pipeline.
  Base TRC/color transforms, sharpening, clarity, RAW and photographic effects are not
  reproduced. File registration/readback cannot establish visual equivalence.
  No real-camera wireless registration, proprietary Nikon pairing, photographic effect
  comparison, tablet, enlarged-font, TalkBack, physical gestures or performance certification.
  See docs/preset-template-preview.md and docs/wireless-import.md for implementation limits.
